1932, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK. NO. 5.
Page 32 Cont.
May 4 -- Thomas Brothers Fallen away - Man losing wife ... and faith - away for years from confession.
Clifford Martin - 11 - mastoid ....
Mrs. C. Van Dorper - 51 - lost breast in Febr. with cancer. Not healing satisfactory.
Mary Hechel - 9 - blind for 3 years. Mary Sweeney - 76 - burned with turpentine
Page 33 May 8 Helen Tyrone - 8 - of Ont. - tubercular bone. Mrs. Cunningham - Sore Br'st ...
Mrs. Mae Line( -- ) married eleven years - now only child 4 weeks old very sick .... Wm. Landrey - Asthma, etc - Rec. Hospital ..
Brozawiski B W - Gervase Dauer John Mckinnon - Back broken 2 years - poorly Non Cath. - 18 years old - tubercular bone and running sore leg Girl 11 Curved Spine
Page 34 May 10th John A. Stibich - 19 - of Johnstown, Penn. - now in Harper Hosp. has T. B. - Colapse of lung said to be the only remedy. This boy's Brother, Clarence Stibich had sleeping sickness two yrs. ago when he was carried into the Monastery and blest - after two other blessings - one at curbstone in the machine and another in .... now in perfect health. He had suffered from the sleeping for two years. Drs. giving no hope of recovery.
Thomas Manian whose name we mentioned as hopelessly infected with "strepticoctic" is home with family -- seemingly
